description: Find all airport lounges accessible with a specific credit card, membership program, airline club, alliance status, or ticket class. For example, find all lounges you can access with your Amex Platinum or Priority Pass membership. Pass airport to limit the results to one airport, e.g. the lounges an Amex Platinum card opens at JFK.

access_method.description: Access method slug (e.g. amex-platinum, priority-pass, chase-sapphire-reserve, business-class, star-alliance-gold)

airport.description: Optional airport IATA code (e.g. JFK, LHR). Only lounges at this airport are returned.

name: find_lounges_by_access
title: Find lounges by access
